title: A customer question about Password and Account Rules

question.author: member_181
question.body: I need a short answer about password and account rules. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Security documentation says: Password resets are handled by verified email. The Security panel of the web app lists all active sessions and lets you sign out individual devices. Repeated failed login attempts trigger a temporary lockout and an email notification. Account passwords must be at least 12 characters and cannot appear in known breach lists. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
